column1: # The prebuilt engines of the engine sources at this commit, a line for each
# platform: the engine key (scripts/engine-key.sh: the git trees of
# CHROMIUM_VERSION, args, patches, and //pane), the platform, and the SHA-256
# of its archive, an asset of the engine-<key:12> prerelease, which the update
# check, reading the latest release, never sees: the Mac's (mac-arm64)
# <platform> publishes one and overwrites its line. A tag reads its own tree's,
# and every key shipped stays a prerelease.
